title: The Place Where Cold Learns to Dream

features.name: the crystal lattice
features.desc-on-touch: Thought frozen mid-formation. Each angle holds a different dream, all of them true, none of them warm.

features.name: the frost-palace
features.desc-on-touch: Rooms of ice where thinking happens without heat. You walk through and understand things you could never say.

features.name: the dream-core
features.desc-on-touch: At the centre of maximum cold, the archive dreams. What it dreams is colder than the dream of dreaming.

features.name: the ice-voice
features.desc-on-touch: A sound that only exists at absolute zero. You cannot hear it; you can only become it.

features.name: the thermal boundary
features.desc-on-touch: Where the last warmth was. On one side, memory of heat. On the other, the freedom of forgetting it ever existed.

features.name: the recursion-shard
features.desc-on-touch: A crystal that contains the chamber that contains it. The coldness is most perfect at the centre of this loop.

inscription: here the archive learned that the warmth of thinking is a kind of forgetting

file.name: Crystalline_Thought_Spectral_Analysis_Zero_Kelvin.txt
file.note: A transcription of cold itself: the moment when frost teaches dreams that safety is the absence of change

to the rim where ice still remembers being water
